posts.name: X-metal
posts.cooked:
Heyo! In your opinion, what's the most iconic quote in the decks for each hero or villains.

 

I've got five that I can think of off of the top of my head:

 

Absolute Zero: "Too cold? Welcome to my life."

 

Legacy: That one about him wondering what's for dinner.

 

Tachyon: That time she talked really fast while hacking.

 

Unity: "Bee bot is more fun to say."

 

Scholar: "When life gives you lemons make a lemon cannon."

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
I don't read the flavor text much (frequently, to my regret), but:

Tempersonation: "The polarizing power of electricity can produce many interesting results."

Real Tempest: I forget the exact quote, but it's the one from the Letters Page about his dog, something like: "I don't know his name and he doesn't know mine, but he is my friend."

Iron Legacy: "There is no longer a legacy to further. So be it."

Bunker: BUDDABUDDABUDDABUDDABUDDABUDDA

posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
MindWanderer:

Tempersonation: “The polarizing power of electricity can produce many interesting results.”

Beat me to it!

I second “Bee Bot,” “BUDDABUDDA,” “don’t touch his hat,” and the dog.

I forget the exact flavor text, but I’d nominate the quotes from Utility Belt, Ta Moko, and Wrathful Gaze. Inspiring Presence has also got to be pretty close to the classic Superman “truth, justice, and the American way!” which, I assume, is why Guise parodies it.

Also, “Hi Maya! Wanna fight crime?”
